verdict.rationale: Twilio's own docs describe porting a number you own into Twilio, a no-code portability check, and an API for creating port-in requests of up to 1,000 US non-toll-free numbers per request, so Twilio itself files the port. The evidence never explicitly says Twilio collects the losing carrier's account details or a letter of authorization, and the documented port-in API covers only US non-toll-free numbers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of collecting losing-carrier account details and the LOA, coverage beyond US non-toll-free numbers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the porting workflow.
